name: TSG IT Advanced Systems Ltd
summary: TSG IT Advanced Systems Ltd delivers cutting-edge technological products and solutions across vital sectors such as national security, public administration, and municipal services. Their comprehensive portfolio includes sophisticated command and control platforms, intelligence and information management systems, and emergency preparedness and response solutions. The company also excels in telecommunications, IT infrastructure, and artificial intelligence applications. Further specializations involve robust cyber defense, strategic facility planning, establishing telecom call centers, optimizing space and asset utilization, critical infrastructure control, and advanced debriefing and recording systems. Serving a diverse clientele, TSG IT Advanced Systems Ltd partners with government bodies, military units, local authorities, private businesses, and various industrial enterprises. Established in 1969, the company is headquartered in Or Yehuda, Israel.
